context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on dealing with bureaucrats
purpose: Teach: 役人/図っ/担う/立案/当方/所管/登記/全額

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 役人相手は、当方から先に立案を見せるのが鉄則だ。
lines.en: With bureaucrats, the rule is to always show your planning first. It sets the tone.
lines.style: Measured, patient opening. Quiet weight behind each phrase. Speaks from accumulated experience without needing to advertise it. Even cadence, no rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。所管の局長との定例の打ち合わせを、私が担う形で進めております。
lines.en: Yes. I'm handling the regular meetings with the department director myself.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Clear, organized tone—this is someone reporting competently. Steady eye contact. No apology in the voice, just solid information.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 登記の件は、相手の顔を立てるよう図ってきたか。
lines.en: On the registration matter—have you made sure to preserve their dignity in the process?
lines.style: Probing but not unkind. Slightly slower pace on 「相手の顔を立てる」—checking whether the younger man understands the subtle work. A teacher's pause built in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい、誠実に進めています。
lines.en: Yes. I'm conducting everything with integrity.
lines.style: Quiet, direct. No elaboration—he understands the question being asked beneath the question. Calm confidence. Brief because the moment calls for brevity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 費用の問題が出たら、全額会社負担を申し出ろ。信頼が違う。
lines.en: If the question of costs arises, immediately offer to cover the full amount. That shift in trust—it matters.
lines.style: Firmer now, almost gentle firmness. Not a lecture, but a deliberate piece of counsel. Spoken like something learned the long way. Slight emphasis on 「信頼が違う」—the payoff of the gesture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Solemn, respectful close. Slow intake at the beginning—absorbing the weight of what was just said. Quiet sincerity. Not performative respect, but genuine.
